name: Abhishek
lede: Product designer in Gurugram. I design B2B and B2C products end to end, from research and flows to motion, and I build with AI along the way.
about: I turn complex requirements into interfaces people understand at a glance. Over the last 1.5 years I've designed internal tools, consumer apps and campaigns, and I prototype fast with Claude, Cursor and Framer so ideas get tested, not just talked about.
facts: Figma, Framer, Claude, Cursor, Adobe CC

projects.title: Truck tracking
projects.summary: A redesign of shipment tracking inside FarMart OS, so business users can follow every delivery with clarity and confidence.
projects.overview: FarMart OS is the internal platform FarMart's operations teams use every day. Working with two product designers and the engineering team, I redesigned the truck tracking experience to make shipment visibility simpler and easier to trust.

projects.title: RoarINK
projects.summary: A zero-to-one mobile app and responsive website, plus the component library that made them consistent and quick to build.
projects.deliverables: Mobile app, responsive website, design system
projects.overview: I led the end-to-end UI and UX for RoarINK's mobile app and responsive website, giving the brand one cohesive presence across platforms. I worked in an agile setup with four engineers and two stakeholders.
projects.outcome: A library of reusable UI components and thorough design documentation made developer handoff faster and more streamlined.

projects.title: AI brand creatives
projects.summary: AI-driven ad creatives for FarMart's staple brands, TrulySafe and Sugarwatchers, made for digital campaigns and brand promotion.
projects.overview: For TrulySafe and Sugarwatchers, FarMart's staple brands, I create ad creatives with AI-driven workflows, producing high-performing assets for digital campaigns and brand promotion.

projects.title: Kirana Club
projects.summary: Daily video content and data-informed in-app banners for a platform built for India's neighbourhood stores.
projects.deliverables: Video content, in-app banners, brand partnership creatives
projects.overview: At Kirana Club I produced and edited daily video content for the app and social platforms, designed in-app banners and promotional creatives, and worked with consumer brands on bespoke campaign creatives.
projects.outcome: Average daily viewership grew to around 6,000 to 6,500 views, and the data-informed banners significantly improved click-through rates on key campaigns.
